title: Return Noble USDC escrow to the migration multisig and freeze the Agoric USDC voucher
summary: Circle ends USDC support on Noble; the full pause is on 2027-01-12. This proposal returns Noble's full USDC escrow for Agoric (87,016.970394 USDC, Noble channel-21) to the multisig noble1REPLACE_WITH_MULTISIG over channel-62 (MsgReturnToNoble with that explicit amount), covering all Noble USDC vouchers (ibc/FE98AAD68F02F03565E9FA39A5E627946699B2B07115889ED812D8BA639576A9) still in circulation on Agoric. In the same execution it disables bank sends of the voucher, so the holder snapshot is the height emitted by the usdcmigration_return_to_noble event. Holders are repaid off-chain from that snapshot: REPLACE_WITH_REPAYMENT_PLAN_URL.
